text: Only eyes that sparkled with delight for meeting someone who carried stories with her. Who was one. A man who could not be tempted with glory for glory’s sake. A fine ruler of Erribathe, and the despair of his son. Foliana’s head turned in the memory, and she met Erin Solstice’s gaze. That was who she’d killed. And this…Foliana pointed a finger at the smiling King of Myths holding the pitcher. This was her foe.
